entities.name: Vijayabahu's Liberation and Parakramabahu the Great

entities.summary: King Vijayabahu I's liberation of Sri Lanka from Chola rule, the golden age of Parakramabahu I who unified the island and built the vast Parakrama Samudra reservoir, and the splendid architecture of Polonnaruwa.
